pages.text: Life Energy is formless - only the force of Chishi can solidify it. The Life Energy Purifier draws on two energies:$(br2)$(li)$(2)Chi Energy$(/2): drives the machine, max input 1M/t$(li)$(2)Life Energy$(/2): the material, supplied via Life Energy Pipes$(br2)Each operation consumes $(bold)10M Chi + 1000 Life Energy$(/bold) and produces 1 Life Essence Solid.

With Chi Energy fed at full rate, one operation takes about 10 ticks. Progress resets when Life Energy runs out, and pauses when the output is full.$(br2)The product goes into the right output slot, extractable with hoppers, AE2 or Item Pipes - the foundation of all later Life research.
